influences.name: The Knife
influences.context: my sister showed me this band, The Knife. Their vocals were pitch-shifted really aggressively; super high, super low, and they'd just sing the whole song like that. I really loved their music and that opened the door for me to experiment with that sound

influences.name: Frank Sinatra
influences.context: Initially inspired by Frank Sinatra's Over the Rainbow

influences.name: his siblings
influences.context: my siblings were into it, and my mom always played the good stuff—so I grew up appreciating good music

influences.name: his sister Rachel
influences.context: she's eight years older, and when I was a kid, she basically dictated my taste in music

influences.name: peers in the DIY scene
influences.context: Hearing something a peer made that was so impressive—it floored me. And I just wanted to emulate that

influences.name: Rolling Stones
influences.context: I was listening to the Rolling Stones – there's something about their recordings that feels haphazard, but they are so easy to listen to at the same time.

influences.name: Neil Young
influences.context: The title track on Headlights has a deep guitar tone that is inspired by "Unknown Legend" by Neil Young. I come back to the 1992 Neil Young album Harvest Moon, too.
